checkpoint_readme:
# Validated thumbnail-navigation preferences

Exact source `1a49a30f058d47ea29cf6ea1f1dc919d14d9f243`, full Linux run
[37644009033](https://github.com/jkendall327/hydrus-mine/actions/runs/37644009033).
Exactly three existing preference leaves gain sign-off: **373 signed,
2 existing candidates pending**. All {GUI_PASSED} GUI and {MEDIA_PASSED} media tests passed.
Prior 370, unselected assessments, native 1799 and all 1274 goal IDs remain intact;
exactly the three selected sign-off flags change. Goal outside explicit ledger: 901.

The saved Shift last-hit origin, strict keyboard reveal threshold and raw scroll
rate reach the actual grid. Original pointer/Shift/Right/Down/wheel histories,
Cancel/retained late Apply, defaults/import/normalization and persistence/reopen
assertions remain. All 17 old GUI assertions and one test are preserved bytewise
in order, together with the preceding 48 assertions; 57 current assertions in the
same test, preserving all 51 intervening macros. The 19 model assertions in
three tests are unchanged. No navigation algorithm
or Options Slint change is introduced by this layout/capture repair.

Root and independent reviewer2 inspected four defining fresh frames:
thumbnail-navigation.png (700×600, sidebar 280 and two columns),
thumbnail-navigation-sidebar-wide.png (1100×700, requested sidebar 400),
and saved true/40/0.5 and false/1/1.5 Options at 1000×900. Complete paired captions
and actual saved CheckBox/number/rate controls were readable in these frames.
Real bounded timer/render settling and default-off read-only geometry observation
check supported allocation containment and separation; no observer forces
geometry or settings. Narrow caption pairs stack, while adequate widths retain
horizontal placement. A finite ordinary sidebar wheel may expose a clipped
lower domain row before the final narrow capture; this follows original grid
inputs and does not replace navigation behavior.

Native stacking is an explicit framework accommodation. Qt source has horizontal
paired QPushButtons; wider sidebar imagery is contextual, with no identical
narrow-state pixel comparison. The navigation recorder produces JSON only.
Default three-line/page-capped Qt wheel behavior versus Winit 60 px normalization,
fractional/platform accumulation, horizontal scrolling/direct scrollbar input,
masonry and nonfinite/int-range conversion differences remain explicit. Invalid
text retains prior saved text; accepted nonfinite raw values remain saved while
the prior native step is retained. Private recorder MPV disabling does not prove
preview playback. Preview-focus siblings, sidebar/Options/navigation parents,
aliases, universal geometry, OS chrome and deferred platforms receive no credit.

The failed b3f09e2f1 run retained 710 passing GUI tests, one failed new geometry
case, 67 passing media tests and the redundant-borrow Clippy diagnostic. Its two
Options frames are diagnostic only; both Main frames were absent. The lint-only
6fc8f7106 source was never dispatched. Current repair adds explicit inherited
style side padding and settles the real viewport resize before requesting wide
geometry. Frozen logs, both earlier source reviews, the isolated lint probe,
actual two-image diagnostic record and repair/generation proofs remain history;
they grant no completion credit. The failed 9e4b3c592 run passed strict Clippy but again retained 710 passing GUI
tests, one new narrow visibility failure and 67 passing media tests. Its three
Options/wide diagnostic images grant no credit; narrow Main was absent. Current
visible content derives an intrinsic scroll minimum; hidden content minimum
stays zero. One pointer movement and wheel through the measured padding gutter
requires positive real extent, actual offset/row translation and fresh stable
observation for at least 35 ms within the original two-second deadline. No
scroll setter, retry or relaxed containment is used. Both failed runs and their
frozen diagnostic/source proofs remain historical. All four accepted frames
are fresh at this exact repaired source.

Actual desktop/narrow browser reviews, final independent packet, source/census,
raw logs and preservation proof are retained. Cached exact Slint generation is
compiler-only and distinct from hosted Rust/runtime validation. Historical author
metadata remains provenance. Cumulative 133 since 240 across twenty-three
checkpoints is not a last-24-hour count. Routine performance remains separate.
